question: Do same-point quadrature precision and fitted coordinates remain stable on independent ordinary and wider-tail PCM data?
simulation: Independent standard-normal draws times sigma; PCG64, inverse-CDF category draws; no response editing, selection or redraws
model: Complete person x 4 raters x 5 criteria, categories 0:4, unit slopes, mean fixed zero, sum-zero raters and criterion-specific steps
gh_starts: Neutral structural start at sigma 1 and selected continuous reference
selection: Smallest independently reevaluated objective among the two starts, retaining every start, first return and restart return
structural_bounds: Unbounded; compare app likelihood at the same coordinates without claiming app-native fitting
target_interpretation: Pre-run engineering budgets, not clinically/educationally meaningful differences or scientific acceptance margins. GH target failures are results, not failed arithmetic checks.
independent_checks: R scalar continuous integration and statmod GH at each selected endpoint; app likelihood, gradient and EAP/SD at each selected GH endpoint; full-coordinate finite differences
external_scope: Grid formulas are same-point checks only. No new native TAM, ConQuest or mfrmr fitting in this stage.
limitations: Four datasets are numerical development probes, not a recovery or coverage study
Two starts cannot establish a global optimum
No SE/CI/coverage qualification or default changes
Do not add conditions or retries after seeing results; record failures
